# Version 4.150.6 (Unreleased)
> **GPU upload failure checks**

## Highlights

The collected 4.150.6 changes improve Ganesh task-status and GPU-buffer upload failure handling.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Distinguish failed GPU work** — Tracks task execution separately from success so intermediate submission failures are not mistaken for successful flushes. ([#5258](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5258))
- **Reject failed buffer uploads** — Checks pool uploads, static and GL helper initialization, and null mipmap-buffer allocations to avoid using stale data. Preserves CPU triangulation data for a later upload attempt. ([#5323](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5323))
